body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 6). Select boxes and other inputs render a drab yellowish-brown in dark mode, which does not fit the indigo theme in `index.html` (`html[data-theme=dark]` sets `--sheet`, `--paper`, `--ink`, `--soft`, `--line`, `--edge`, `--hover`, `--focus`).

- Set `color-scheme` per theme in `index.html` so native dropdowns, date pickers and scrollbars render dark in dark mode.
- Give `select`, `input`, `textarea` and `button` the theme tokens in the base styles of `solace_task`, `solace_board`, `strategy` and `settings`: `--paper` background, `--ink` text, `--line` border, `--hover` on hover, `--focus` on focus; no page hard-codes a color.
- Options lists inside native selects follow the scheme, so the yellowish panel is gone.

**Tests:** the theme switch test in `settings` stays green; page tests assert no literal color values in the input styles.
title: ui: Dark-mode input colors
